verdict.rationale: First-party docs say BigQuery's native GoogleSQL dialect is ANSI-compliant and is the primary way to analyze data. It also ships procedural extensions and pipe syntax, and a hands-on community review notes QUALIFY, which implies window-function support. None of the specific features the story lists are explicitly documented in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of window functions, CTEs, JSON type and functions, ARRAY/STRUCT types, and rich date/time types, plus independent corroboration of these.
